subject.title: feat: trazar reviewedAt/reviewedBy en cada revisión de producto (acepte o rechace)

question: How should historical `acceptedAt`/`acceptedBy` values be treated when introducing `reviewedAt`/`reviewedBy` per product?
rationale: The code change is clear, but preserving or backfilling historical review semantics affects reports and BigQuery and needs an explicit data decision before implementation.

options.title: Compatibility read without backfill
options.body: Add `reviewedAt`/`reviewedBy` going forward while mapping old `acceptedAt`/`acceptedBy` for accepted historical products where consumers need it.

options.title: Backfill historical accepted products
options.body: Run a controlled backfill that copies accepted metadata into reviewed metadata for old accepted product rows, with no inferred reviewer for rejected rows unless another source is approved.

options.title: Hard rename only
options.body: Rename consumers to the new fields without compatibility, accepting that historical acceptance timestamps may disappear from current reports until a separate migration runs.

recommendation.title: Compatibility read without backfill
recommendation.body: Add `reviewedAt`/`reviewedBy` going forward while mapping old `acceptedAt`/`acceptedBy` for accepted historical products where consumers need it.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to AlexDiaz-Hamelyn and the requested behavior is scoped to the Admin review flow plus downstream data handling.
